title: Cost-aware live controls: conditional κ = 5.103512721785e-5
body:
This PR composes PR #67's cost-aware retired-slot selection with compatible pending live controls at both axes and refines the assembly backoff. The conditional bound is

$$
T(n)=O\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{1020702544357}{20000000000000000}=5.103512721785\times10^{-5}.
$$

The exact gain over PR #67 (`10206752116843/(2*10^17)` at `b3745601e947a94316bf25c2c6263d93c06e3364`) is **273326727/(2*10^17)**. Bit saving: **51037731934993/10^18**. Both new physical words, their complete paid profiles and the exact assembly have passed focused independent validation. **Newer PRs #69, #70 and #71 claim stronger bounds; this PR is not the current global frontier.** All inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses remain conditional.

## Change

At h=23 and h=25, extend Rohan Arun's PR #67 clearing basis with pending live carriers satisfying **F ⊆ E ⊆ G**, where F is the current carrier frame, E the clearing region and G its assigned next-use frame. PR #67's integer profile-cost heuristic chooses a valid dependency; every chosen carrier is used through the literal XOR routine and both physical transitions remain charged.

| Quantity | PR #67 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| h=23 auxiliary roles | 27,918 | 27,918 |
| h=25 auxiliary roles | 36,586 | 36,586 |
| Physical wires W | 137,151,806 | 137,151,806 |
| h=23 clearing XORs | 1,415 | 1,420 |
| h=25 clearing XORs | 1,950 | 1,942 |
| Bit saving | 51036365162009/10^18 | **51037731934993/10^18** |
| Conditional κ | 10206752116843/(2*10^17) | **1020702544357/(2*10^16)** |

All data pairs, copied centers, endpoints, the complex branch and assembly costs remain charged. The complete rank mass remains 78,860,441,550 with deficit 1,846,900. The discovery cost is a heuristic; acceptance depends on the physical word and full paid moment.

A final parameter-only refinement reduces assembly backoff from `10^-12` to `10^-18`, gaining exactly `153/10^18` in κ with the same physical words and bit saving. Its common eventual cutoff increases from `14,000,000,000,000` to `14,000,000,000,000,000,000`. No parameter or construction optimality is claimed.

## Verification

Independent checks passed: complete serialized dirty-state replay of both words, exact frame/scalar/scatter checks, literal paid transition reconstruction, actual C++ fixed-basis profiles (**6,049/7,997 CRT matrices, zero disagreements**), complete paid rank identity, exact adjacent moment bracket, all **47 strict constraints and seven margins**, and next-grid rejection. The parameter-only refinement was separately reproduced from its pinned physical receipt and exact sources; its certificate matches exactly.

The committed physical candidate preserves its initial publication-time pending flags as a historical snapshot. The separate validation receipt records the completed physical checks. The latest assembly parameters are in `research/cost-live-parameters/certificate.json`.

```sh
make cost-live-verify
python3 research/cost-live-parameters/refine.py
make verify
```

The first target is integrated into `make verify` and the Python 3.11/3.13/3.14 CI matrix. It reruns complete physical validation followed by the parameter certificate check. Full current-head repository checks and CI review remain pending. Upstream workflows require maintainer approval; the fork runs automatically.

Inherited joint-package Makefile/README/NOTICE hashes and derived certificate links were refreshed after integration. Ten focused replay/failure controls and the independent PR #60/#61 arithmetic audit passed; the inherited mathematical certificate is unchanged. All existing verification and formal groups remain enabled.

Commit: `b1b2af3415ecb494a0552b16c18045bf3ee05e95`. [Physical proof and scope](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b1b2af3415ecb494a0552b16c18045bf3ee05e95/research/cost-live-both/PROOF.md), [physical validation receipt](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b1b2af3415ecb494a0552b16c18045bf3ee05e95/research/cost-live-both/validation-receipt.json), [word/compile receipt](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b1b2af3415ecb494a0552b16c18045bf3ee05e95/research/cost-live-both/frame-compiler.json), [parameter proof](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b1b2af3415ecb494a0552b16c18045bf3ee05e95/research/cost-live-parameters/PROOF.md), [final exact certificate](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b1b2af3415ecb494a0552b16c18045bf3ee05e95/research/cost-live-parameters/certificate.json), [source pins](https://github.com/DominikScholz/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b1b2af3415ecb494a0552b16c18045bf3ee05e95/research/cost-live-parameters/source-manifest.json).

No finite check here proves the inherited all-size compiler, residual transfer, analytic/routing/recovery or fixed-tape multiplication theorem, global optimality or practical speedup. Earlier research snapshots remain separately attributed in their own directories.
